question: Is DNg100_L's network ignition carried by one (or a few) of its direct postsynaptic partners? If a single partner's silencing prevents the ignition, does a front-left MN rhythm appear?
not_claimed: anything about the live LIF engine
a change to weights, mappings or motor admission
known_before: R4 reported DNg100_L's network out-degree (70) and two-hop intermediates to the core. No partner has been silenced or its activity under DNg100 drive inspected.

sources.cache: maleCNS cache (load_cache verifies the canonical source fingerprints)
sources.hash_rule: text files: sha256 after CRLF -> LF; .bin/.flys and evidence result.json: sha256 of raw bytes

conditions.partners: P = every network local index j != DNg100_L with W[j, DNg100_L] != 0 (R1's signed matrix), ascending
conditions.per_arm: all stimulate DNg100_L: STIM; SIL_SHAM (R5 rule: one cell per replicate, default_rng(seed + 7,000,000), eligible = network cells not DN/AN/front-left MN/E1/E2/I1/DNg100_L's two-hop intermediates to the core/P); SIL_GROUP (all of P); SIL_<dense> per partner in ascending order
conditions.order: I2 first; then R1SIZE, then VNCSIZE; within an arm STIM, SIL_SHAM, SIL_GROUP, then partners ascending
conditions.storage: every run stored; per-MN detail only for runs with score >= 0.5

model: R1's model and R3's replicate function unchanged; no weight changes; silencing holds activation at 0
readout: R3's: median recruited, MN score and frequency, E1/E2/I1 trace rhythmicity, activity, mean rates; IGNITED = median recruited >= 500 (R2 RANGE_MAX)

acceptance.validity: per arm: STIM and SIL_SHAM IGNITED, else INVALID
acceptance.class: PREVENTS_IGNITION if SIL_j not IGNITED; NOT_NEEDED otherwise
verdict_order: DISTRIBUTED_IGNITION: none singly, SIL_GROUP not IGNITED
acceptance.secondary: per arm among PREVENTS_IGNITION partners: RHYTHM_UNMASKED if any SIL_j has score >= 0.5 and median E1 trace rhythmicity >= 0.5 (NaN fails); NO_RHYTHM_UNMASKED otherwise; NOT_APPLICABLE if none prevents

reported_not_gated: each partner's body ID, name, transmitter, weight from DNg100_L, network out-degree, two-hop-intermediate flag
per-partner recruited, score, frequency, E1 trace and activity

integrity.I1: source hashes; R1 network body-ID hash; DNg100_L dense index resolved from body ID 10045; P non-empty; R1b z*/m_VNC reproduced
integrity.I2: hard gate: R1SIZE R7 DNg100_L g = 1 runs seeds 4001-4004 and VNCSIZE R3 DNG100 runs seeds 1001-1004 (8 simulations) equal the stored runs exactly (score, recruited, core activity)
integrity.I3_tests: tests/test_dng100_ignition_source.py passes (partner rule on toy W; validity, classes and verdict order; secondary rule; expectations; I2 check)
integrity.I4: 2 x (|P| + 3) x 16 simulations plus 8 reproduction simulations

expectations.note: recorded in the design before any R8 simulation; wrong ones are recorded as wrong

plumbing_disclosure: Before registration one R1SIZE DNg100_L simulation at seed 0 (not a protocol seed) was timed (0.80 s); no partner was listed; its score and rates were not printed. Unit tests use toy inputs only.
execution: one command (--output) lists the partners, runs I2 and all conditions, and evaluates in the same process; output opened exclusively; run once in the background.
interpretation_limits: Direct partners only, singly and as a whole group; no subsets or two-hop cells.
One drive per size version; R1's isolated 2,111-neuron network.
Reconstructed rate model; R1's transmitter signs; 68 bodymap MNs.
Neural only: no body or physics; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
